verdict.rationale: Codex documents MCP client support. You can add local or remote MCP servers, authenticate, and inspect their tools, and this configuration is shared across the CLI, IDE extension, and desktop app. It also offers plugins to 'connect Codex to your team's tools and data', and Codex cloud can start work from Slack channels and threads and from Linear issues. Missing for 10: no documented Jira or Google Drive integration (only the generic MCP/plugin path), Slack is shown as a task-launch surface rather than a context source, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of these integrations.
